---
title: "Stage 8.1 — Multi-benchmark persistence results"
output: html_document

params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "resume"                   # inspect | resume
  optimization_curves: null         # null = all completed Stage 6 curves
  main_curve: "q50"
---

Stage 8.1 compares the prioritization pipeline with ABF, CAZ1, CAZ2, and
CAZMAX. Run chunks directly; knitting is not required. In a fresh session,
`setup → results` regenerates all tables from complete exact-target libraries
without invoking spatial reconstruction.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage81_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("8.1_report_results.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage81")
rmd_params <- configured$params
config <- stage81_config(rmd_params)
stage81_plan <- stage81_target_plan(config)
```

```{r inspect}
stage81_readiness <- inspect_stage81(config, stage81_plan)
print(stage81_readiness)
```

```{r lookup-libraries, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  stage81_lookup_status <- resume_stage81_lookups(config, stage81_plan)
  print(stage81_lookup_status)
}
```

```{r results, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  stage81_results <- build_stage81_results(config, stage81_plan)
}
```

```{r cross-benchmark-summary}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage81_results", "results")
  print(stage81_results$cross_benchmark$late)
  print(stage81_results$cross_benchmark$sequence)
  print(stage81_results$cross_benchmark$retained_area)
}
```

```{r late-stage-results}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage81_results", "results")
  lapply(stage81_results$methods, function(result) {
    print(result$report_tables$primary_late)
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r sequence-results}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage81_results", "results")
  lapply(stage81_results$methods, function(result) {
    print(result$report_tables$primary_sequence)
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r retained-area-results}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage81_results", "results")
  lapply(stage81_results$methods, function(result) {
    print(result$report_tables$primary_area)
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r robustness-matrices}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage81_results", "results")
  lapply(stage81_results$methods, function(result) {
    print(result$report_tables$robustness)
    lapply(result$report_tables$late_matrices, print)
    print(result$report_tables$sequence_mean)
    print(result$report_tables$sequence_directions)
    print(result$report_tables$area_mean)
    print(result$report_tables$area_directions)
    print(result$report_tables$stability)
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r main-figure, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (identical(config$mode, "resume")) {
  stage81_figure <- build_stage81_figure(config, stage81_plan)
  print(stage81_figure$focal_results)
  print(stage81_figure$figure_path)
}
```

```{r artifact-summary}
stage81_artifacts <- stage81_artifact_summary(
  config, stage81_plan,
  if (exists("stage81_figure")) stage81_figure else NULL
)
print(stage81_artifacts$lookups)
print(stage81_artifacts$runtime_logs)
print(stage81_artifacts$figure)
```
